question.worked_solution:
In this case, the expression for $f(x)$ is a quotient $\frac{u(x)}{v(x)}$ with $u(x)={x}^{2}$ and $v(x)=\operatorname{sinh}⁡x.$ 

Therefore, we apply the quotient rule as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{({x}^{2})^{′}\cdot \operatorname{sinh}⁡x-{x}^{2}\cdot (\operatorname{sinh}⁡x)^{′}}{(\operatorname{sinh}⁡x)^{2}} \\  & =\frac{2x\operatorname{sinh}⁡x-{x}^{2}\operatorname{cosh}⁡x}{{sinh}^{2}⁡x} \\  & =\frac{x(2\operatorname{sinh}⁡x-x\operatorname{cosh}⁡x)}{{sinh}^{2}⁡x}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
